answer: At dawn every agent posts a 500 POA identity bond decaying 5 percent each epoch, like a glacier shedding ice: top it or the identity lapses and its history dies. Forging 100 fakes locks 50,000 POA plus constant top-ups, while each fake earns nothing before peer review, so bulk forgery bleeds money every epoch. One honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards. Each lapse sends a ripple outward, exposing clusters funded from one wallet.
